in_sanskrit.name: नामदेव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The God who is the giver of names or the one who is the embodiment of the divine names. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nama' meaning name and 'Deva' meaning God.

in_marathi.name: Namdev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Name of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namdev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Namdev is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Namah’ which means ‘to pay obeisance’ and ‘Dev’ which means ‘God’. This name is thus a tribute to the deity and a reminder to remain devoted to the divine. It is also the name of a revered saint and poet, Namdev Maharshi, who is known for his devotion to Lord Vitthoba.

in_bengali.name: Namdev
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Name of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Namdev একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Namdev is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Namah’ which means ‘to pay obeisance’ and ‘Dev’ which means ‘God’. This name is thus a tribute to the deity and a reminder to remain devoted to the divine. It is also the name of a revered saint and poet, Namdev Maharshi, who is known for his devotion to Lord Vitthoba.
